findings.highlight: why Knights-san was so beautiful at first
findings.evidenceJa: 急に華やいじゃったなぁナイツさん
findings.explanation: The venue contact jokes that Knights Records has suddenly become more glamorous now that Setsuna is handling the account. He is not wondering why a person called 'Knights-san' looked beautiful at first.
findings.japanese:
「そうですかぁ。こちらこそよろしく。
いや、急に華やいじゃったなぁナイツさん。
小木曽さんだっけ？　ステージの方も出たりするの？」
findings.todokanai: "I see. Likewise, then. I was wondering why Knights-san was so beautiful at first. You were Ogiso-san, right? Do you appear on stage too?"

findings.highlight: pay for my daughter's education
findings.evidenceJa: 娘の養育費も稼がないと
findings.explanation: 養育費 is the cost of raising or supporting her daughter, not specifically tuition or educational expenses. Youko is joking about having to earn Kazusa's keep.
findings.japanese:
「社長ですもの。
社員を食べさせる義務があるの。
ついでに娘の養育費も稼がないと」
findings.todokanai: "I'm your company president. I have a duty to make sure my workers can eat, not to mention that I have to earn enough money to pay for my daughter's education."

findings.highlight: since 5 AM
findings.evidenceJa: 朝から五時間ぶっ続け
findings.explanation: Kazusa has been playing continuously for five hours since the morning. The translation turns the duration into a 5 a.m. start time.
findings.japanese: 「…これで朝から五時間ぶっ続けよ？」
findings.todokanai: "…You've been at it since 5 AM, you know?"

findings.highlight: Try to keep the pace, would you?
findings.evidenceJa: なんとか、もってよね
findings.explanation: Youko is privately urging herself or her body to hold out for one more day. This is about endurance under her illness, not maintaining Kazusa's rehearsal pace.
findings.japanese: 「なんとか、もってよね…」
findings.todokanai: "Try to keep the pace, would you?"

findings.highlight: done with all the magazines before noon. The only job remaining was the compiling of the interviews
findings.evidenceJa: 雑務の方は午前中で終わってしまい、後はインタビューの起こしだけが残った
findings.explanation: Haruki finishes his miscellaneous work by noon and has only interview transcription left. The English invents magazines and weakens 起こし from transcribing recorded interviews to vaguely compiling them.
findings.japanese:
気を紛らすために仕事をしようとしても、
雑務の方は午前中で終わってしまい、
後はインタビューの起こしだけが残った。
findings.todokanai: I tried distracting myself with work, but I was done with all the magazines before noon. The only job remaining was the compiling of the interviews.

findings.highlight: lying down on the bed
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋の床に寝転がってしまった
findings.explanation: Haruki lies down on the floor of the room, not on a bed. The physical self-neglect in the scene is erased.
findings.japanese:
けれど、今はとてもあいつの声を聞く気になれず、
結局、そのまま部屋の床に寝転がってしまった。
findings.todokanai: But I couldn't bring myself to listen to her voice. In the end, I found myself just lying down on the bed like this.

findings.highlight: She would've done so earlier if she had forgiven me. And she would've done so much later if she began to trust me again.
findings.evidenceJa:
俺を許していたなら、もっと前に。
俺を信じ切っていたなら、もっと後になるはずだった。
findings.explanation: 信じ切っていた is complete ongoing trust, while 'began to trust me again' introduces a recovery process — The earlier-versus-later timing contrast is preserved.
findings.japanese:
俺を許していたなら、もっと前に。
俺を信じ切っていたなら、もっと後になるはずだった。
findings.todokanai: She would've done so earlier if she had forgiven me. And she would've done so much later if she began to trust me again.

findings.highlight: That's why, this time… is our final farewell.
findings.evidenceJa: 今度こそ、今度こそ…これで、さよならだ
findings.explanation: The remembered line emphatically repeats 'this time' twice: 'This time, this time... this is goodbye.' The translation invents 'That's why' and removes the deliberate repetition.
findings.japanese:
『今度こそ、今度こそ…
これで、さよならだ』
findings.todokanai: "That's why, this time… is our final farewell."

findings.highlight: Nothing good would come from being with you.
findings.evidenceJa: あんたと一緒だと時間がもたないから
findings.explanation: Io says she cannot fill or sustain the time when she is with Takeya—the conversation drags. She does not say that being with him produces bad consequences.
findings.japanese:
「嫌よ。
あんたと一緒だと時間がもたないから」
findings.todokanai: "No way. Nothing good would come from being with you."

findings.highlight: If only they could resolve it by themselves, with just the two of them
findings.evidenceJa: 二人で済んでればいいんだけどな
findings.explanation: Takeya hopes the problem involves only Haruki and Setsuna. He is worried a third person is involved; he is not saying the couple should resolve it without help.
findings.japanese: 「二人で済んでればいいんだけどな…」
findings.todokanai: "If only they could resolve it by themselves, with just the two of them…"

findings.highlight: be with him throughout the whole concert
findings.evidenceJa: 開演までずっと一緒にいて
findings.explanation: Takeya proposes staying with Haruki until the concert begins, then arranging to go home together afterward. The English instead has them accompany him throughout the performance.
findings.japanese:
「そんなの簡単だ。
偶然だなって声かけて、開演までずっと一緒にいて、
コンサートが終わったら一緒に帰る約束をすればいい」
findings.todokanai: "That's simple. We'll greet him and say 'fancy seeing you here,' then we'll be with him throughout the whole concert and make plans to all go home together once it's over."

findings.highlight: wrap things up for now
findings.evidenceJa: とにかく早く切り替えることだ
findings.explanation: Her manager tells her to reset mentally and move on quickly so she can handle tomorrow's work. He is not telling her to finish or wrap up the current task.
findings.japanese:
「次に活かしてくれればいい。
まだ明日もそちらでの仕事が残ってるんだから、
とにかく早く切り替えることだ」
findings.todokanai: "Just make sure it goes well next time and everything will work out. You still have work left to do over there tomorrow, so wrap things up for now."

findings.highlight: I just felt like I had to see you in person
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、雪菜に直接連絡しなければって
findings.explanation: Haruki rationalizes that it might remain within their rules so long as he did not contact Setsuna directly; he obtained her whereabouts through her family. The English reverses that into a need for direct personal contact.
findings.japanese:
「ルール違反気味ってのはわかってる。
ただ、雪菜に直接連絡しなければって…」
findings.todokanai: "I'm aware that that's breaking the rules. I just felt like I had to see you in person, Setsuna…"

findings.highlight: waiting to receive her with a smile on my face
findings.evidenceJa: あいつが満面の笑顔で応えてきたら
findings.explanation: Kazusa is the one who might respond to Haruki and his bouquet with a radiant smile. The translation transfers the smile to Haruki and turns Kazusa's response into his act of waiting.
findings.japanese:
全てが終わったあとの控え室で、花束を抱えた俺に、
あいつが満面の笑顔で応えてきたら…
findings.todokanai: Had I stood in the waiting room once the concert was over with a bouquet in my hands, waiting to receive her with a smile on my face…

findings.highlight: hold back my own feelings
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の気持ちを強く保てるかどうか
findings.explanation: Haruki doubts whether he could keep his feelings firm or remain steadfast after Kazusa smiled at him. 'Hold back' recasts the problem as suppressing desire rather than maintaining his chosen resolve.
findings.japanese:
その時俺は、
自分の気持ちを強く保てるかどうかがわからない。
findings.todokanai: Then I can't be sure if I'd be able to hold back my own feelings.

findings.highlight: it didn't end up stopping because it froze over
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たく凍った訳じゃなかった。凍ったまま、乾いてしまったようだった
findings.explanation: Time has frozen, but not with coldness; it feels frozen and dried out. The English introduces an unrelated causal denial about why time stopped and breaks the dry-freeze metaphor.
findings.japanese:
けど、冷たく凍った訳じゃなかった。
凍ったまま、乾いてしまったようだった。
findings.todokanai: But it didn't end up stopping because it froze over. It was more so as if it dried up.

findings.highlight: under the pretense that someone had asked her to pass it to me
findings.evidenceJa: 『人から預かった』と俺に差し出した
findings.explanation: Kazusa handed him the ticket saying she had received it from someone. The Japanese does not call this a pretense; that word adds an unsupported judgment that the explanation was false.
findings.japanese:
かずさが『人から預かった』と俺に差し出した、
雪菜の参加してたライブチケット。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa had offered me a ticket to attend Setsuna's live performance under the pretense that someone had asked her to pass it to me.

findings.highlight: forgotten about public appearances
findings.evidenceJa: 自身の恥も省みず俺を責めた
findings.explanation: Setsuna condemns him without regard for her own embarrassment, despite the surrounding customers watching. 'Public appearances' is not the meaning and sounds as if she has forgotten scheduled performances.
findings.japanese:
それほどまでに雪菜が、
自身の恥も省みず俺を責めたのは…
findings.todokanai: Setsuna had forgotten about public appearances and condemned me…

findings.highlight: no matter what happens to you
findings.evidenceJa: 今日だけは何があっても、あなただけは何があっても
findings.explanation: Setsuna says 'today of all days, no matter what—and you of all people, no matter what.' The second phrase emphatically singles Haruki out as the person who must hear Kazusa; it does not mean regardless of what happens to him.
findings.japanese:
「どうしてそんなことするの？
今日だけは何があっても、あなただけは何があっても、
かずさのピアノを聴かなくちゃならないはずだよね？」
findings.todokanai: "Why would you do such a thing? No matter what happens today, and no matter what happens to you, you have to listen to her play the piano, don't you?"

findings.highlight: doesn't mean she has the confidence to do it
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜の方には自信があるって訳じゃ、なかった
findings.explanation: Although Setsuna can rebuke Haruki, that does not mean she herself feels secure or confident about their relationship. The English narrowly makes the confidence concern her ability to lash out.
findings.japanese:
俺を叱咤できるからと言って、
雪菜の方には自信があるって訳じゃ、なかった。
findings.todokanai: Just because Setsuna says she's capable of lashing out at me, doesn't mean she has the confidence to do it.

findings.highlight: let me pretend that I'm angry at you
findings.evidenceJa: 今は建前で怒らせて
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks to be allowed, for now, to speak from the principled or publicly defensible position and say only what is right. 建前 does not mean her anger is feigned.
findings.japanese:
「だけど、今は建前で怒らせて。
すごく原則的なこと言わせて。
正しいことだけ、言わせて」
findings.todokanai: "But right now, let me pretend that I'm angry at you. Let me admonish you with my principles. Let me say only the right things."

findings.highlight: I might actually remember her saying them back then rather than today
findings.evidenceJa: 未来から思い返したら、本当にそんな日として記憶されるかもしれない
findings.explanation: Haruki fears that when he looks back from the future, today may truly be remembered as the day they parted. The translation invents a competition between remembering the words as spoken 'back then' and today.
findings.japanese:
いや、未来から思い返したら、
本当にそんな日として記憶されるかもしれないって
思わせる、雪菜の台詞だった。
findings.todokanai: No, I could even say that if I were to recall them in the future, I might actually remember her saying them back then rather than today.

findings.highlight: a misguided, yet utterly virtuous woman
findings.evidenceJa: 聖女過ぎる悪女
findings.explanation: Haruki calls Setsuna a 'villainess far too saintly': her excessive goodness enables his moral collapse. 'Misguided, yet virtuous' removes the deliberately accusatory saint/villain paradox and substitutes a different fault.
findings.japanese:
俺を甘えるだけの情けない男へと、
言い訳ばかりのずるい男へと堕落させてしまう、
聖女過ぎる悪女。
findings.todokanai: She's a misguided, yet utterly virtuous woman who's degrading me into a miserable man who only wants to take advantage of her. She's turning me into someone who will give her nothing but excuses.

findings.highlight: I've never wanted to tell her
findings.evidenceJa: 今ほど強く思ったことはなかったから
findings.explanation: Haruki says he has never more strongly felt or wished that she would remain this awful man's girlfriend. The Japanese does not say he wanted to voice that thought to her.
findings.japanese:
『ずっと、その最低男の彼女でいて欲しい』って、
今ほど強く思ったことはなかったから。
findings.todokanai: Because I've never wanted to tell her "I want you to remain as the girlfriend of this despicable man" more than now either.

findings.highlight: won't ever be able to repeat those resolute words ever again
findings.evidenceJa: 二度も口に出す勇気なんかないから
findings.explanation: Haruki lacks the courage to say such a momentous line twice now, so he saves it for the next opportunity. 'Ever again' contradicts the explicit plan on the following line to say it later.
findings.japanese:
だって、こんなもの凄い決意を込めた台詞、
二度も口に出す勇気なんかないから。
findings.todokanai: Because I won't ever be able to repeat those resolute words ever again.

findings.highlight: The further away I get, the less clear Setsuna's expression becomes.
findings.evidenceJa: 離れるにつれ、雪菜の表情が段々と歪んでいく。
findings.explanation: Her expression grows distorted as distance increases; 'less clear' makes it only a loss of visual resolution — The next line restores the ambiguity between smiling, crying, and Haruki's own distorted vision.
findings.japanese: 離れるにつれ、雪菜の表情が段々と歪んでいく。
findings.todokanai: The further away I get, the less clear Setsuna's expression becomes.
